blocks.x: I'm sure you were. I'm sure they used to do some wild things, I mean the, the Brunies ballets too.

Oh, oh, oh, Abbie especially. Abbie was a, he was a, he was a, he was a heckler from way back. He used to, he had, before I went with him, he had Snatchy Rogers, Emmet Rogers, used to play with him. And they, they, they used to, uh, clown a lot, you know. Abbie sit up on top of the piano, playing the piano, playing the trumpet and that, you know. You know how they did and all that. Yeah. And he kicked Snatchy in the head, you know, like that. While he was sitting up there on top of the piano. So, and I, I, I took Emmet's place, I told him, I said, look, let me tell you one thing. The first time that you kicked me in the head while you sitting up on that piano, I'm gonna take the Snatchy and put it around your neck for her necklace. But I know that I ain't never there playing the tricks on me, but they used to play some awful tricks out there. Oh, I've heard of you. Oh.
